## Simone Weil on attention

Simone Weil (1909–1943) approaches attention within Christian mysticism. Attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity—emptying the self to receive reality and the neighbor. Affliction (malheur) destroys the “I” and reveals both social crushing and spiritual possibility. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets attention most directly—useful for searches such as “simone weil quotes on attention.”
